entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-03-27
entry.content:
Issues

Closed

  • Entity Framework Core not using memory cache from app service provider #38025
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `efcore/release/9.0` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #37970
    9.0.7
  • Global Query Filter: ChangeTracker deletes archived entity upon replacement instead of treating it as detached #37992
  • Add a parameterless AddPooledDbContextFactory overload #34658
    11.0.0
  • Please mention different translation of ToString in "breaking changes" #37935
  • Regression in ExecuteUpdate with lambda-based SetProperty of constant value #38013

Updated

  • Regression between v9 and v10: System.InvalidCastException when query parameter is IEnumerable #38008
  • Json field with value converter when converter converts nulls isn't converted #37983
    11.0.0
  • Checking equality of values with convertible types makes query precompilation fail #38012
    Backlog
  • SQL Server provider: JSON_VALUE should emit RETURNING nvarchar(4000) instead of RETURNING nvarchar(max) to avoid Azure SQL engine crash #37991
  • TPC returns incorrect items when using generic entities #35727
    Backlog
  • Add customization for dotnet ef migrations bundle project #36083
    Backlog
  • SqlServerSingletonOptions.EngineType is Unknown #36477
    Backlog
  • Scaffold-DbContext flag to force update (without deleting other entities) #37796
    Backlog
  • Switch to using the new SqlClient user-agent feature #36571
    11.0.0
  • Better error message with ExecuteUpdate #37862
    Backlog
  • ExecuteUpdateAsync throws SQLite Error 1: 'no such column: ...' when working with navigation properties in EFCore Sqlite #38010
    11.0.0

PullRequests

Created

  • Cosmos: Modernize JSON serialization - Update pipeline #38024
    community-contribution
  • Fix SQLite ExecuteUpdate with navigation properties and TPT inheritance #38023
  • Fix TPC returning incorrect entity types for generic derived types #38022
  • [release/10.0] Fix InvalidCastException when query parameter is IEnumerable with mismatched enum types #38021
  • Strip identity annotations from temporal history table column operations #38019

Merged

  • Remove file-based seeding for Cosmos DB functional tests #38005
    community-contribution
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #38014
  • Restore sqlite3mc test project using SQLite3MC.PCLRaw.bundle #38015
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #38020
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #38016

Updated

  • Fix run value converters that convert nulls for JSON columns #37984
    community-contribution
  • [release/10.0] Fix SetProperty discard lambda failing for nullable value type properties in ExecuteUpdate #38007
  • Split Helix into separate AzDO jobs per queue, enable verbose xunit, configurable timeout #38003
  • Auto-start Cosmos emulator via Testcontainers #37999
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0' => 'release/9.0' #37908
